items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: He was a man when I was a kid.

ctx.x: Okay. Second reel of interview with Will Shade and Dewey Coley. Okay. It's May the 25th, 1960. Thank you. Keep your mic. All right. We were talking about some of the bands they had around here. Do you remember the names of any other ones when you were a little boy?
Oh, W.C. Handy and Howard Yancy, B. Smith. And, uh, oh, quite a few of them. I forgot the name right at the prison. Can't call them right now. So jumped up on me.
How about Howard Yancy? How old was he?
